The company operates two facilities that combine a machine shop with a parts warehouse.
The Tucson and El Paso stores stock thousands of part numbers across categories such as rotating assemblies, gaskets, bearings, and performance components from hundreds of aftermarket brands.
Customers range from independent repair shops and engine builders to industrial maintenance teams and performance enthusiasts.

The product lineup serves the automotive aftermarket, heavy-duty diesel, and industrial engine sectors, with specific coverage for brands like Detroit Diesel, Honda, and a wide array of racing and performance manufacturers.
